raw_blocks: We are a global leading motion control technology company accelerating mobility to be safe, green and exciting. Our innovative product and technology portfolio includes electric and hydraulic power steering systems , steer-by-wire systems , brake-by-wire , steering columns and intermediate shafts , driveline systems and software solutions .

We solve motion control challenges across all megatrends – including electrification, software/connectivity, ADAS/automated driving and shared mobility – for more than 60 customers around the world including BMW, Ford, GM, RNM, Stellantis and VW, as well as automakers in India and China including BYD, Chery, Great Wall, Geely, Xpeng and others.
We have locations around the world including 27 manufacturing plants, five technical centers and 13 customer service centers across six continents.
"WE ARE THE LEADING MOTION CONTROL TECHNOLOGY COMPANY ACCELERATING MOBILITY TO BE SAFE, GREEN AND EXCITING."
By putting safety first - always
By creating a cleaner future through sustainable manufacturing and designing for a zero-emission world
By solving complex mobility challenges, simplifying life and connecting people

We are transforming our vision into reality by challenging the impossible and differentiating ourselves through our culture, product quality & performance, mobility megatrend alignment, relentless innovation and more.
MAKING TOMORROW BETTER THAN TODAY

Our culture is truly our competitive advantage. We are committed to a collaborative and inclusive environment that inspires and empowers , and this enables us to achieve our vision to be the global leading motion control technology company accelerating mobility to be safe, green and exciting.

Our global team spans regions, cultures, internal functions and divisions, and we believe that diverse viewpoints always yield better decisions and creative problem-solving. Thanks to our global footprint and extensive in-house resources, employees can develop unique personal growth plans that match their long-term career goals.
Click here to learn more about our culture and career opportunities around the world.

As a global leader in Intuitive Motion Control, we are headquartered in Metro Detroit, located across six continents in close proximity to our customers, traded on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange – and digitally connected under one global roof.
5 THINGS TO KNOW ABOUT NEXTEER & WHAT IT MEANS TO YOU

Faster-to-market product development cycles via quick, iterative design approach. Access to a cross-functional, advanced technology team. Time and cost-efficiencies via smart capitalization on Nexteer’s in-house technologies and building blocks supporting mobility megatrends
GLOBAL MANUFACTURING FOOTPRINT & PROWESS
A high-quality, proven manufacturing partner for safety-critical systems…in every market where you need to be
IN-HOUSE OWNERSHIP OF R&D, DESIGN, TESTING & MANUFACTURING
Agility, responsiveness, quality and value
Seamless integration: “Vehicle-level thinking” is in our DNA
DEPTH & BREADTH OF PRODUCTS & TECHNOLOGY
Steering & Driveline Systems, as well as Software solutions for small cars to heavy duty trucks around the globe.
RELENTLESS INNOVATION IS PART OF OUR CULTURE

Our innovation is fueled by our in-house ownership of R&D, design, testing and manufacturing and our focus on global, cross-functional collaboration. In-house development and full system integration of hardware, software and electronics provides us with a competitive advantage as an agile, full-service supplier to automotive OEMs around the world.

We work with our customers to develop tailored solutions to solve motion control challenges across all megatrends. We’re committed to developing industry-leading motion control solutions that enable advanced safety, performance and convenience for today and an increasingly electrified, connected and automated future.
We can’t talk about our proprietary projects; but, we can tell you that we are relentlessly innovating within Nexteer and through joint development projects with:
– Automotive OEMs – Industry Disruptors – Collaborative, Industry Peers
NEXTEER + TACTILE MOBILITY: SOFTWARE COLLABORATION FOR NEXT LEVEL “STEERING FEEL”
Our collaboration focuses on motion control software to enable advanced software offerings that maximize over-the-air updates and connectivity for even safer, more reliable driving.

We recently announced a software solution to improve overall vehicle health management, safety and performance by detecting changing road surfaces (wet, dry, icy, etc.) and evolving tire conditions (tire stiffness, tread depth, etc.).
VEHICLE-LEVEL THINKING & SYSTEMS INTEGRATION: IT’S IN OUR DNA

In 2010, our company was reborn with the name of “Nexteer” – carrying with it more than 100 years of automotive heritage. Since our inception, Nexteer has created a recent history of profitable growth and industry leadership. We have grown our footprint – opening new plants in China, India, Indonesia, Mexico and Morocco and expanding our technical capabilities within new technical centers in Poland, China, India and Mexico.

We have also showcased our commitment to relentless innovation – from launching the first full-size truck REPS system in 2011 to unveiling our suite of advanced steering technology in 2018 to being named a 2021 Automotive News PACEpilot Innovation to Watch for our Steer-by-Wire with Stowable Steering Column and more. Over the years and across global markets, Nexteer’s leadership in technology and other areas have garnered many awards.

Looking ahead, Nexteer remains highly focused on aligning with industry megatrends and realizing our vision to be the global leading motion control technology company accelerating mobility to be safe, green and exciting.

raw_blocks: Shaping the future of the software-defined chassis

Software-defined vehicles (SDVs) and the introduction of ‘by-wire’ technologies mark a transformative new era in mobility – where software is not just an enabler, but the core driver of vehicle innovation and value.

Nexteer’s MotionIQ software suite is the intelligence powering our ‘Motion-by-Wire’ technology portfolio – including Steer-by-Wire (SbW), Rear-Wheel Steering (RWS), and Brake-by-Wire (BbW) – as well as our industry-leading Electric Power Steering (EPS) systems.

By combining these advanced technologies with our safety-critical software expertise, Nexteer is shaping the future of the software-defined chassis – enabling seamless systems integration, significant development cost savings, and speed-to-market for our OEM partners.
Interested in learning more about our software solutions?
Nexteer’s cutting-edge suite of intelligent motion control software solutions.

Engineered on proven algorithms deployed in over 115 million vehicles worldwide, MotionIQ software streamlines chassis control, development and vehicle health-monitoring workflows into a single suite, delivering significant cost and time savings for OEMs across the automotive, off-road, commercial vehicle and other adjacent mobility sectors.

MotionIQ/Control brings advanced vehicle dynamics functions that transform safety, performance and driving comfort by intelligently controlling steering and braking systems. Combined with Nexteer’s Steer-by-Wire technology, these software functions revolutionize “behind-the-wheel” experiences – enabling OEMs to deliver next-gen driving experiences that excite consumers and differentiate their brands.

Steer-by-Brake software uses the vehicle’s electronic brakes to steer the vehicle while also controlling its speed – enabling safety redundancies without the cost and complexity of additional hardware.
Hands-Off Detection software enhances safety by monitoring driver engagement and sending an alert when hands are off the wheel for too long in ADAS-equipped and semi-to-fully autonomous vehicles.

Quiet Wheel™ Steering software enables the steering wheel to remain still during autonomous driving modes and ADAS maneuvers – eliminating the potential hazard of a fast-rotating steering wheel and enhancing the driver’s sense of security and comfort.
Road Surface Detection software enables vehicles to “feel” the road by collecting real-time road friction data via virtual sensors with unprecedented accuracy and availability.
MotionIQ/Dev delivers advanced software tools – backed by Nexteer’s systems integration and software development expertise – to accelerate feature development for OEMs.

These tools, combined with Nexteer’s flexible customer-first approach, enable OEMs to design and integrate their own in-house steering features, all while adhering to Nexteer’s internal standards and processes to ensure seamless compatibility, performance and safety.

Nexteer’s Model-based Development Tool accelerates steering feature development from days to minutes through automated coding and integration – cutting costs, reducing lead times, and minimizing time spent on error-prone manual coding. Its user-friendly modeling interface allows OEMs to safely design their own in-house steering control algorithms and seamlessly integrate new features across both prototype and production – all within a no-code, model-based environment.

With decades of expertise in developing and integrating safety-critical embedded software, Nexteer’s global team of engineers act as an extension of our customer’s teams to accelerate speed-to-market and drive efficiencies. We focus on delivering end-to-end software development, integration, validation and more with agility, responsiveness and quality for our customers.

MotionIQ/Health leverages Nexteer’s prognostic software and AI-powered virtual sensors to continuously monitor the electrical and mechanical functionality of steering and other chassis components as well as tires. This improves consumer satisfaction by predicting issues before they occur, minimizing costly fleet downtime, enabling convenient maintenance scheduling, and significantly reducing diagnostic time, errors, and expenses.
Tire Health & Tire Parameter Detection

Our Tire Health & Parameter Detection Software, in collaboration with Tactile Mobility, utilizes smart tire virtual sensors (no additional hardware required) to allow the monitoring of tire/road condition fit automatically.
Continuously monitors the electrical and mechanical functionality of steering and other chassis components in actual lifecycle conditions, proactively enhancing safety and performance.
Why Choose Nexteer as Your Motion Control Software Partner
Our global engineering teams champion ASIL D certified agile software development processes, enabling efficient delivery, rapid prototyping and product flexibility.
GLOBAL IN-HOUSE EXPERTISE FROM DESIGN TO VALIDATION

Global in-house ownership of software design, development, testing and validation ensures adherence to quality standards and compliance with customer specifications, industry protocols and regulatory requirements.

Proven industry leadership in safety-critical solutions with 115+ million EPS systems, as well as award-winning Steer-by-Wire (SbW) systems, that include varying levels of software and cybersecurity per our OEM customers’ requirements.
Benefits of the Software-Defined Chassis

Advanced software-enabled technologies, like Steer-by-Wire, Electric Power Steering , Brake-by-Wire and Rear-Wheel Steering , allow OEMs to program component software to feel different across various vehicles, such as a luxury SUV, a pickup truck or a sports car - even if the same hardware system is used across different vehicles.
Accelerated Development For Reduced Costs

With software tools from MotionIQ/Dev, engineers can make real-time updates during vehicle testing, accelerating steering feature development from days to minutes— all with little to no coding expertise.

Software-defined vehicles are moving towards a more centralized system for more integrated, updatable and flexible architectures. With proven systems integration and software expertise, Nexteer helps OEMs build centralized architectures for coordinated control across chassis systems and actuators

Nexteer’s Level 1-4 virtual ECU (V-ECU) and other virtual engineering capabilities reduces costs for customers by enabling system-level software verification much earlier in the development cycle, allowing for testing and issue detection even before hardware or physical prototypes are available.
